_doc: Map ground tuning. mode: flow | old | off. Ported from realm-snapshot aesthetics/04-flow-field-synthwave.html. Tempo, clock and reduced motion come from Pulse (configs/pulse.json). Figure over ground: streak_width_px is on-screen width at any zoom; spawn_empty_weight sets how sparse the empty-ground current is (each streak legible, alpha_empty) and spawn_land_weight thins held ground the same way; seam_land stops empty-ground streaks piling up on living rims, clump_limit stops them piling into sinks (reads last frame's trail); moat_* thins streaks beside live lanes (lane_bow mirrors map_routes.gd's bow). density_exp keeps on-screen ink constant across zoom. Debug keys on the map: F5 vsync, F6 reload this file, F7 cycle mode, F8 reduced motion (Pulse, game-wide), F9 greyscale check.

drift_floor._doc: DriftFloor (scripts/fx/drift_floor.gd), the shared town/dungeon floor. density = streaks per 100x100 px; speed = px/s at drift strength 1; the exhale surges speed and length on Pulse's beat; tint = a Palette key (never dead); the head is lifted to head_contrast against the ground (faint by sparsity, never below the 3:1 line floor at the head).
